purpose: Visual proportion and silhouette references for generic parked vehicles in CampusExterior
implementation: Seven parked variants now show reused detailed Hatchback or Motorcycle meshes already in CampusExterior, with 3 LODs, scaled silhouettes and existing paint variants. Original primitive children remain inactive except selected spoiler, roof rails and touring luggage, preserving local fileIDs. Front lens materials are dark and nonemissive. No brand marks, external meshes or source textures were copied.
